task.title: Run migrations and documentation rebuild checks
task.shortdesc: Apply database migrations, validate documentation source, and rebuild the static documentation output after the source revision changes.

prereq.p: The checkout and dependencies have been refreshed successfully, and the database backup evidence was collected while BPM was stopped.

context.p: Updates may introduce database migrations and documentation changes. BPM 0.9.0 documents forward migration with alembic upgrade head; it does not promise automatic downgrade or safe schema rollback.

step.cmd: Apply database migrations to the intended database.

info.p: Use the actual deployment value for BPM_DATABASE_URL. Stop immediately if migration output is unclear or fails.

step.cmd: Run a narrow source smoke check before serving users.

info.p: This check is a source smoke, not a production certification or HA validation.

step.cmd: Validate and rebuild documentation output for the updated revision.

info.p: make docs-validate checks DITA, metadata, source links, and generated links. make docs-build rebuilds ignored static output; it does not by itself install a default documentation artifact into the application runtime.

step.cmd: Stop on migration, smoke, or documentation rebuild failures.

info.note: After a migration has run, do not assume Git checkout rollback is enough. Do not run alembic downgrade unless a reviewed release note explicitly says it is supported for the exact revision pair. Use the pre-update database backup as the safe recovery baseline when rollback is required.

result.p: The updated source revision has completed migrations, source smoke, and documentation rebuild checks, or the update has stopped at a named failure point.

postreq.p: Start BPM and run the post-update verification topic before handing the instance back to users or integrators.
